canonical_project: Tencent Western Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Chongqing government says Tencent's Chongqing cloud data center in Liangjiang International Cloud Computing Industrial Park covers about 250 mu with RMB 6 billion investment and, when complete, 200,000-server compute/storage capability. People's Daily Chongqing reported phase 2 energization in July 2022.
